_comment: Enacted amending Laws and published figures that the income-tax rows rely on, recorded 2026-10-07. The Hebrew consolidation in ../ is Wikisource's unofficial text; where it and these differ, these are the enacted text. A statute is deposited as the PDF; a government publication that is not a statute is recorded by link and hash only (the convention in each SOURCE-LICENSE.md: such publications are carried as short quotations, not deposited). Both were fetched by the capstone's encoder (row legalese-2026-10-il-07) from Internet Archive captures; the lead re-checked both sha256 values against the bytes at deposit.
